newsitem.title: USA: CANTV shares surge in Wall Street debut.
newsitem.headline: CANTV shares surge in Wall Street debut.

text.p: Shares of Venezuelan telephone company CANTV surged three to $26 per ADR on the New York Stock Exchange within their first few minutes of trading.
Company officials have said they hope to raise between $900 million and $1 billion in the sale, one of the biggest international offerings out of Latin America this year.
CANTV is an acronym for Compaa Annima Nacional Telfonos de Venezuela.
GTE Corp on Wednesday said it would buy up to $200 million of the offering, thus increasing GTE's individual stake in the company to 26 percent from 20.4 percent.
More than 80 percent of the CANTV shares are to be sold as ADRs listed on the NYSE and in London. Each will represent seven Class D shares.
Shares were offered this week in Venezuela and orders there totaled $313 million, far above the official target of $200 million.
